description: Defines a data class 'Todo' representing a to-do item with properties, constructors, serialization/deserialization methods, and equality/hashCode overrides.

classes.name: Todo
classes.description: Represents a to-do item with properties such as id, title, subtitle, completion status, and timestamps; provides methods for copying, serialization, and deserialization.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current Todo object with optional overrides for its properties.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the Todo object into a Map suitable for storage in SQLite.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a Todo instance from a Map, e.g., a database row.

methods.name: _parseDate
methods.description: Helper static method to parse a dynamic value into a DateTime object.
